description: Track I I2: budgeted invention rounds over a domain's held processes (commutator, conjugate, compose, inverse, powers, roots), novelty and precision by effect, conjugation closure, discovered laws, and a yield-guided strategy library.

microtheory.name: invention_round
microtheory.description: Invent by algebra over held processes; keep what is new by effect and precise.

rules.name: ir_open_round_on_impasse_budgeted
rules.comment: Open an InventionRound for the domain (impasse); request its cost from ThinkingBudget through the generic pending-request contract.

rules.name: ir_open_round_on_impasse_unbudgeted
rules.comment: Open an InventionRound for the domain (impasse) directly when the agent holds no ThinkingBudget at all.

rules.name: ir_open_round_on_offline_budgeted
rules.comment: Open an InventionRound for the domain (offline); request its cost from ThinkingBudget through the generic pending-request contract.

rules.name: ir_open_round_on_offline_unbudgeted
rules.comment: Open an InventionRound for the domain (offline) directly when the agent holds no ThinkingBudget at all.

rules.name: ir_round_funded
rules.comment: A round whose budget request was approved becomes active.

rules.name: ir_round_denied
rules.comment: A round whose budget request was denied is closed as denied.

rules.name: ir_invent_commutator
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `commutator` over pairs of held processes in the round's domain; mint the result only if it is novel by effect, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_invent_conjugate
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `conjugate` over pairs of held processes in the round's domain; mint the result only if it is novel by effect, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_invent_compose
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `compose` over pairs of held processes in the round's domain; mint the result only if it is novel by effect, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_invent_inverse
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `inverse` to each held process in the round's domain; mint if novel, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_invent_power2
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `power2` to each held process in the round's domain; mint if novel, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_invent_power3
rules.comment: I2.2: apply `power3` to each held process in the round's domain; mint if novel, not the identity, and precise.

rules.name: ir_record_square_root
rules.comment: I2.1 root(2): a held process x whose square has the effect of an invented process a is recorded as `x -root_of-> a` (a search over the library, not a mint).

rules.name: ir_conjugation_closure
rules.comment: I2.3: conjugate every precise invention by every held process; mint novel conjugates of the same precision. Iterated to fixpoint this is closure under conjugation by any word of held processes (the probe's three_cycle_closure, as a rule).

rules.name: ir_law_order_2
rules.comment: Law: the smallest k with a^k = identity on the probes (here k = 2).

rules.name: ir_law_order_3
rules.comment: Law: the smallest k with a^k = identity on the probes (here k = 3).

rules.name: ir_law_order_4
rules.comment: Law: the smallest k with a^k = identity on the probes (here k = 4).

rules.name: ir_law_order_5
rules.comment: Law: the smallest k with a^k = identity on the probes (here k = 5).

rules.name: ir_law_order_6
rules.comment: Law: the smallest k with a^k = identity on the probes (here k = 6).

rules.name: ir_law_commute
rules.comment: Law: two held processes commute when their commutator is the identity on the probes.

rules.name: ir_law_conjugation_inverts
rules.comment: Law: b·a·b⁻¹ = a⁻¹ (b reverses a), when a is not its own inverse.

rules.name: ir_strategy_record_mint
rules.comment: I3.3: keep one StrategyRecord per (domain kind, operator) the agent has tried.

rules.name: ir_strategy_record_update
rules.comment: I3.3: yields = inventions minted by the operator in domains of this kind; trials = candidate applications offered by rounds that enabled it.
